items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua officially ACTIVE despite calf injury; optimistic reports confirmed he would play vs Raiders.
items.why: Schefter and Rapoport confirmation after ETR GTD/optimism and Rams sources saying no setbacks.
items.implication: Start Puka with full confidence; calf minor per McVay.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets expected in favorable matchup.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall officially INACTIVE (quad); unlikely earlier and missed fourth straight game after limited practice.
items.why: Rapoport sources + Schefter actives/inactives list; ETR pessimism confirmed.
items.implication: Sit Hall; continue monitoring for Week 8 ramp-up.
items.opportunity: Full lead role for backup RB vs soft MIA run D.

items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled OUT for Week 7 after questionable designation with ankle injury; third straight miss.
items.why: ETR weekend summary and corroborating reports of high ankle sprain downgrade.
items.implication: Sit Lamar; Ravens backup QB starts vs CIN.
items.opportunity: Boost to Ravens pass-catchers and CIN defense matchup if Huntley starts.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs ankle turn on purposeful slide: almost certainly fine; no real concern for availability or role.
items.why: Levitan direct take post-ETR watch list; would have been tilting if truly hurt avoiding TD.
items.implication: No downgrade; continue as elite RB1.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY Monday vs DAL after returning to practice from hamstring; limited Friday but on track.
items.why: ETR summary; Berry notes efficient prior games and great DAL matchup for RBs.
items.implication: Strong start candidate if active; volume RB1 upside.
items.opportunity: Workhorse snaps/carries/red-zone vs weak run D.

items.text: Eagles WRs DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) both OUT for MNF vs DAL.
items.why: ETR final weekend summary matching official reports.
items.implication: Sit both; Eagles pass game thinned.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining WRs/TE, higher Goedert usage.
items.conflict: Berry had pre-injury Love on Smith.

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs listed IN/ACTIVE for return after layoff.
items.why: ETR IN list; Rapoport noted return to field.
items.implication: Monitor snap share post-layoff; startable but caution.
items.opportunity: Potential lead back carries if full go.
items.conflict: Berry Hate due to workload uncertainty after layoff; Thorman noted elevated 71% neutral pass rate in return.

items.text: Jaxon Smith-Njigba steals show again in Seahawks statement win over Chiefs; tremendous per reports.
items.why: Rapoport post-game highlight of continued elite production.
items.implication: Confirm WR1 status ROS; start every week.

items.text: Cam Skattebo: thinks actually hurt (hamstring) but not certain; watched alongside Tracy.
items.why: Levitan player-specific conclusion after ETR injury watch.
items.implication: Caution on Skattebo; possible reduced role or risk.
items.opportunity: If limited, boost to other Giants RBs.
items.conflict: Rapoport earlier noted Skattebo back as lead; Berry Hate on matchup.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI (usage/matchup); Bears good for yardage, Brown back in real role.
items.why: Berry Love/Hate: elite volume potential vs vulnerable Bears secondary.
items.opportunity: High targets/routes in positive game script.

items.text: Loves Tucker Kraft @ DET; Lions TE buffet (9 TE TDs allowed), Kraft gets the boost.
items.why: Berry: Detroit vulnerable to TEs, Kraft volume upside.

items.text: Loves volume RBs Jaylen Warren @ NO, Chuba Hubbard vs TB, Bucky Irving @ CAR for big workloads in friendly matchups.
items.why: Berry RB Love: consistent volume + defenses carved by RBs.
items.implication: Start all three as RB2/flex with upside.

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze (Gonzalez shadow, outside targets), Josh Downs (target share/low-scoring), Travis Kelce (tough SEA D).
items.why: Berry: nasty matchups and role issues.

items.text: Hates Josh Jacobs (workload Q after layoff) and Cam Skattebo (brutal HOU spot).
items.why: Berry RB Hate list matching Levitan Skattebo concern.
items.conflict: ETR/Jacobs IN and potential volume; Thorman high pass rate note.
